messages:
deploy-bot: 🚦 initiating staged rollout: service=redwood-api version=v8.3.1 target=8% region=eu-central change_window=22:00-02:00 UTC details=https://deploys.internal/rollout/5076543210
matt: heads up — small model-tokenization tweak in this build. QA smoke passed.
rina: telemetry: eu-central p95 increased ~25ms right after rollout start, p50 stable. watching.
platform-oncall: seeing two pod restarts on node group c3; exit code 137. attaching short logs.
diego: logs show `FatalError: buffer overflow` in reranker thread. could be a packing change.
kevin: can we hold and run a limited rollback in-region? prefer pinning instead of global rollback.
eva: recommend hold at 8% and spin up debug replica with debug flags to collect heap and trace. we can triage quickly.
matt: agree hold. vote to pause until trace results.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 8% by @matt — traffic frozen.
platform-oncall: applying region pin: `deployctl pin --region eu-central --service redwood-api --version v8.3.0`
rina: pin applied. routed pinned traffic back to v8.3.0.
diego: starting debug replica with `--alloc-trace` now. will post trace link.
kevin: thresholds: if restarts >6 in 10m OR p95 >300ms sustained 2m -> run regional rollback:
```
rbctl rollback --service redwood-api --version v8.3.0 --scope region --region eu-central --reason "canary packing buffer overflow"
```

eva: trace uploaded: https://internal-traces/5076543210/alloc-trace.txt  shows buffer growth in token-packer when batch size >64.
matt: confirms change introduced a new packer path for large-batch consolidation. patch incoming from infra.
rina: rolling metrics look stable after pin; p95 back to baseline.
deploy-bot: reminder: change window ends 02:00 UTC. include `--post-window` for rollbacks after window.
matt: plan: keep rollout paused, merge hotfix to remove new packer optimization, re-run canary with patched image tomorrow in same window.
kevin: preparing rollback notes and customer message draft in case we need to revert further.
platform-oncall: will keep pin until we validate fix. updating on-call doc.
matt: thanks all. brief update in 10m or earlier if thresholds breach. keep thread concise. ✅
